confirmDescriptions.send_confirmation: This sends the same confirmation message as when the reservation was created (to the client email on file).
confirmDescriptions.remind_3d: Sends the standard “3 days before end” reminder template.
confirmDescriptions.remind_1d: Sends the standard “1 day before end” reminder template.
confirmDescriptions.remind_today: Sends the standard “ends today” reminder template.
confirmDescriptions.remind_remaining_days: Sends an email stating how many whole calendar days remain (UTC) until the reservation end date.
confirmDescriptions.send_expired: Sends the notice that the reservation period has ended (after the expiration date in UTC).
